living-armchair-japandi-a.note: Armchair gone; sofa, glass table and TV chest restyled in place, same camera.

living-armchair-japandi-b.note: Armchair gone; sofa, table and TV chest restyled in place.

living-table-boho-a.note: Coffee table gone; sofa, armchair and TV chest in place. Many plants and a floor lamp added (decor).

living-table-boho-b.note: Coffee table gone; sofa, armchair and TV chest in place.

sala-chairs-tropical-a.note: Stacked chairs gone; both sofas and the TV unit in place. A floor lamp and a plant added.

sala-chairs-tropical-b.note: Stacked chairs gone; both sofas and the TV unit in place. A small round side table shows in the bottom right corner (minor).

sala-loveseat-industrial-b.note: Loveseat gone; back sofa, TV unit and the chair by the window in place, walls and frames restyled.

bedroom-nightstand-scandi-b.note: Nightstand and its lamp gone; bed and clothes rail in place.

kids-desk-coastal-b.note: Desk gone and nothing lost, but step 1 moved the chair from the desk to the window.

kids-desk-chair-japandi-a.note: Desk and chair gone; bed and bookcase in place.
